title: Warm White Australian Coconut Skewers
description: A savory and romantic Australian dish featuring coconut flakes and candy, perfect for a special occasion. This nut-free-friendly recipe is sure to delight.

ingredients.name: candy pieces
ingredients.notes: such as gummy bears or sour candies

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the coconut flakes, white chocolate chips, and candy pieces.
Add the pineapple chunks, vanilla extract, and salt to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Thread a piece of pineapple onto each bamboo skewer, followed by a small spoonful of the coconut mixture.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the water over the skewers to help the coconut flakes stick.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the coconut flakes are lightly toasted.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Warm White Australian Coconut Skewers warm and enjoy.
